reviews.text: We have done both group classes and a couple of one to one sessions with Olivia with our GSP and could not recommend Canine Connect highly enough.  Olivia’s methods of training have been very effective and the classes enjoyable to attend for both us and our dog. For both the classes and individual sessions Olivia has always been very prepared and provided excellent support via feedback between sessions.

We are extremely satisfied. She is very dedicated.

👍 …

Canine Connect is truly something special. We can’t recommend Olivia and Clodagh enough to anyone who has a dog or is even thinking about getting one.

They’ve poured so much care, time, and wisdom into helping our Vizsla grow into a happy and healthy dog. Especially their knowledge of working breeds is unmatched, but it’s their genuine love for what they do that sets them apart.

We live in Dublin, but we happily travel to Cork and take online sessions because, we haven’t come across anyone else who comes close to their level of professionalism, passion, and heart.

We’re beyond grateful for everything they’ve done for our little guy — it’s made all the difference.

I don't live in Cork but I reached out to Canine Connect, through word of mouth from a dear friend, for online consultations early this year.

I have an overall happy, well-behaved, confident cocker spaniel. However, this past year/year and a half I noticed his car anxiety increasing - while he is brilliant on adventures out in the wild, getting to and from these places became too much for him.

Since our first consultation, Olivia and Clodagh offered a wealth of experience to help my dog. It's not just about finding what makes him comfortable in the car, but gaining a wide range of skills that can help through many other areas in the dog's life.

Since implementing the recommended actions, we have seen improvements I would've never imagined my dog could do. We have still a long way to go but I feel fully supported in this process. Canine Connect's expertise, eye for detail, dedication to the dog's cause, generosity and kindness to a first-time owner (who has lots to learn!) have truly exceeded my expectations.

100% recommended.

I'm an experienced dog guardian with a background in Labs, GSPs and Vizslas. But I recently looked Canine Connect up to help me with my quirky new rescue dog.

Olivia & Clodagh's knowledge, passion, generosity, and willingness to help knows no bounds. Dogs really are at the centre of what they do.

I've completed the bronze puppy group class, the bronze gun dog class and also had a one-to-one session with Canine Connect and despite already having a fair amount of knowledge, I have learned an enormous amount.

I look forward to progressing through the silver and gold classes.

Canine Connect are helping me help give my rescue dog a good and happy life. They are helping him thrive. I couldn't ask for more.

Highly recommend!

Olivia and Clodagh are the best dog trainers. The courses and classes are designed so well that it’s easy to follow not only for dog owners but for dogs as well. I’m so happy that Bizkit and Pepper had a chance to learn from the best and I’m really looking forward to sign up for other courses in the future.

A must for first time puppy owners. It makes life so much easier.

We enrolled Luna, our lovely Lab puppy, in Canine Connect's bronze course. Their guidance boosted our confidence in training and managing Luna (especially given we are first time puppy owners).

Even the day before the last class we were able to use what we learned to control Luna and enjoy a coffee and sambo in a busy cafe environment.

Luna loved the training—wagging her tail and wiggling with excitement every lesson! 🐾

Olivia and Clodagh, thank you! We highly recommend Canine Connect to fellow dog owners.

We would highly recommend Canine Connect if you need help understanding your dogs needs & in training them. Olivia & Clodagh use gentle methods that will give you great connection with your dogs & are experts in the area.

Working with Canine Connect has brought such joy to our lives. Sue had loved training as a puppy but as she got older there were no opportunities to continue. At 9 she meet Olivia & Clodagh & has taken numerous obedience, agility & gun dog courses. The first lesson is usually human only where we learn about canine body language & how dogs communicate things & this is the foundation of everything. I'm very proud of all the skills Sue has learned but ultimately it's about how happy it makes her. A dog whose needs are meet is a happy dog & the connection Sue & I have training & with dog sports is phenomenal. Olivia & Clodagh go above & beyond to help & support their clients. It was because of their belief & support that I put Sue forward as a Burns by Your Side Reading Dog & at 11 she is training to be a therapy dog. Sue's training motto is: "Everything is awesome when your part of a team."
